This was more evident in the Crocky's Cauldron world and when the camera was pointed at certain angles. [/p][p][/p][p]This patch also fixes some other minor bugs.[/p]

notes.title: 2.0.5 Patch
notes.content:
This patch makes fundemental changes to the way in which model LODs are rendered, making major performance gains especially in the larger areas of the game. With this, we've upgraded the game engine. Save games and other settings are not affected by this update.

We've also fixed some UI bugs, especially for when some elements would stay on screen when grabbing pickups. 

It has also been brought to our attention that security mitigations in Windows 11 can sigficantly alter performance in GEORGIE-YOLKIE ENHANCED. To turn off these features, please visit the Microsoft guide if this applies to you;
https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/options-to-optimize-gaming-performance-in-windows-11-a255f612-2949-4373-a566-ff6f3f474613

We have tested this ourselves on production machines and we've noticed up to a 40% difference in framerates which is major. Let's hope Microsoft addresses this in 25H2.


-Upgraded Engine version to 6.2
-Optimized Mesh LOD levels, further improving performance
-Fixed bug where some UI elements would stay on screen (e.g when picking up a game cart)

notes.title: 2.0.4a Update (Revised)
notes.content:
[p]**Version 2.0.4 – A Big Jump! 🚀**  
This milestone update delivers long-awaited features, performance upgrades, and the return of fan-favorite content—elevating GEORGIE–YOLKIE beyond the Legacy edition in both quality and speed. This version forms the foundation for the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 release, now entering certification.

💾 *Game saves from previous patches remain compatible (excluding Legacy).*

🌟 What's New
- **Revamped Dialogue System**  
  Faces now rendered in full 3D, complete with expressive animations and timing-based speech flow. Players can now skip dialogue segments and enjoy more natural pacing—an overhaul built from scratch and long requested by the community.

- **Enhanced Visual Fidelity**  
  - True-to-life depth-of-field for backgrounds and distant objects  
  - File and World Select screens redesigned for clarity and atmosphere  

⚙️ Performance Improvements
- Faster mesh rendering & refined occlusion culling  
- World load times drastically reduced  
- Memory usage slashed by up to 50%  
- Optimization across upscaling, asset compression, and installation footprint  
- Switched to Mono for parity across platforms and mod support  
- Eye Tracking raycasting enhanced for precision

🐛 Bug Fixes & Quality-of-Life Tweaks
- Environment lighting corrected in Gingy’s Glacier  
- Paths and shadows now render correctly in Home Turf  
- Dialog bugs squashed (no more wrong text when re-talking to characters)  
- Skeleton spawn issues resolved on Ghost Ship  
- Georgie no longer drifts upward during underwater conversations  
- Lanky’s eyelids restored to proper orange  
- Softlock prevention improved during achievement unlocks  
- Numerous graphical layering and bounding box issues fixed  
- Grammar and naming conventions cleaned up for polish

🧃 Restorations & Cut Content
- Portal and ambient sounds reinstated  
- Carrot enemies return to Carrotop Wood  
- Billboard resolution boosted on Isle ‘O’ Rats  
- Original Magey boss fight behaviors restored  
- Environment detail scaling refined for Switch platforms

💻 Platform-Specific Updates
- PC version now supports AMD Fidelity FX 3.1 (Performance Preset)[/p][p]-Fixed a overlay appearing on the bottom of the screen due to Steamworks glitch. We've denoted this small patch with 'A'.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-ktdnkaA9XE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 2.0.2 Patch
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/0416c431c802e25b3d366f671be44a5211fed21e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]We've now added the option to adjust the camera control sensitvity from the Controls Screen. This will allow you to adjust how quickly the camera will orbit Georgie & Yolkie when either rotating the mouse or right control stick.[/p][/*][*][p]We've fixed stuttering / low FPS on the title screen and menus[/p][/*][*][p]Spawned coins, hearts and lives now will take longer to disappear giving the player extra time to collect them.[/p][/*][*][p]A prompt will now appear when attempting to exit the game, in case it was selected by mistake instead of immediately closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the settings menu when opening it in Armo's Arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphical issue on higher fidelity settings that would cause grass and other objects to overdraw and glitch with infinite NaNs count, causing flares.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the portal gradient to the World Select cards for more consistency with the load screen.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed reflections on ground materials.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
[p]We have addressed some issues and further improvement performance, reliability and optimization in the 2.0.1 patch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/2c3dc3b4c7322eccd7b32624d1f1ad0e214d7d4c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p] The game will now automatically benchmark performance of the hardware and set the most optimal settings accordingly. It does this on startup, and takes seconds. We've added this to help players make the most of thier wonderful system and run GEORGIE-YOLKIE, so it basically, uh, doesn't lag. At the bottom you'll now see a whopping long percentage number. This is the base performance of how quickly your PC can render the game, and we will scale everything according to that. (It's not a competition!)[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a set 'optimal defaults button' to Settings, which will re-run the benchmark and apply the best settings automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]We've fixed stuttering issues when under heavy GPU load. [/p][/*][*][p] We've fixed blur material graphics being corrupted or completely transparent on UI surfaces on GPUs forcing DirectX 12 mode.[/p][/*][*][p] The Linux version will now run with Vulkan by default, as opposed to OpenGL. [/p][/*][*][p] We've reduced shader memory overhead.[/p][/*][/list]

[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI depths and blurs for improved visuals.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bug when showing Controls and Switching to Video Settings from World Select Screen [/p][/*][*][p]Loading screen now has a smooth rainbow gradient [/p][/*][*][p]Updated Georgie-Yolkie 64 Bundle version to 1.0.4 [/p][/*][*][p]Dramatically improved Georgie and Yolkie's models and animations, and fixed a myriad of rendering issues with their animation rig. [/p][/*][*][p]Movement is now much smoother, and Georgie leans as he turns more.[/p][/*][*][p]Georgie's eyes are now much more expressive instead of a blank stare, and his iris are now sprites. [/p][/*][*][p]Signficant updates to the Eye Tracking Subsystem for more epressive looks overall. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause Magey Boss to stop working and also have low health randomly. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved Magey's AI. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lag when changing between the different phases of the day. [/p][/*][*][p]Significantly improved raytracing accuracy and prevented temporal jittering on shading darker areas. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio bug when falling from Rattie's Keep. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed long standing issue with swamp water in Bobbly's Bog not animating. Fixed a gap between the wall in the Golden Temple that could cause the player to fall of out bounds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 (Major Content Update Release)
notes.content:
[h2]We are happy to announce the long awaited 1.0.8 Content Update patch for April, nice and early for celebrating this Easter holiday![/h2]

[h3]This Content Update patch adds [b]Armo's Arcade[/b] that was previously locked, unlocks the[b] game cartridges across the worlds[/b] and allows you to play some exciting classic arcade games. Players with the top score will unlock access to something incredibly exciting![/h3]

Along with this, we have also made some further improvements, polishing the graphics, fixing some long standing issues and more. Read further on the full change log!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/a7e9754543dc2bba302f9e6a95e9f0ae89800084.jpg[/img]

[b]Armo's Arcade [/b]- Find the game cartridges across the game worlds to unlock access to the arcade machines! We've also added a shortcut on the World Select Menu so you don't have to keep going back to the Isle O Rats once you've entered Armo's for the first time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/f00f340365b5a230a4ee93a5c01c54cc77551598.jpg[/img]
[b]Game Carts are hidden in all of the worlds of the game. Can you find them all and unlock something really exciting later?
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/40aa13ab459b6426f92047d8980daaee125260ad.jpg[/img]

[b]Robot's Revenge is just one of the classic arcade games now in Armo's Arcade. This is pretty addictive fun and we hope you enjoy![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248884/e5812b2a1d55d833ada7177c42641d7dfd14fa78.jpg[/img]
[b]An example of the graphical enhancements we've made across the game - Water in Gingy's Glacier is lovely now, and Rattie's Keep from the Home Turfs can be seen across the game worlds, helping to interconnect the game's world across the game.[/b]

[b]Changelog[/b]

🎁Content Update
[list]
[*] Added Armo's Cartridges to the game worlds
[*] The barrier blocking Armo's arcade has now been disabled and you can now play his arcade games!
[*] Added trail and particle effects when using Yolkie Homing.
[*] Improved and sped up Georgie's walking, running, air pound, swimming and gravity settings.
[*] Removed the barrier to the Mad March Hare Mansion.
[*] Added achievement for collecting 10 cartridges.
[*] Added achievements for high scores on Arcade games.
[*] Added shortcut button on World Select menu when you have accessed Armo's Arcade for the first time.
[/list]

🖌️Polish
[list]
[*] Fixed Yolkie's animations when launching her as flying animation wasn't working before.
[*] Reduced culling in Home Turf allowing to see maximum distance (restored original release behaviour)
[*] Updated sand depth texture and rendering in Boris' Badlands that was showing incorrect shadows before
[*] Fixed and improved water in Gingy's Glacier not rendering sky reflection properly and looking flat.
[*] Updated title screen graphics.
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed long standing bug that would show static Georgie and Yolkie on the HUD instead of the animated icons when in Rattie's Lair Hub.
[*] Improved loading speed of Home Turf
[*] Fixed Game Totals text being misaligned when in the Gingy's Glacier Level.
[*] Fixed texture and reflection issues in Isle ' O ' Rats
[*] Improved performance in Isle 'O' Rats.
[*] Reduced overall memory usage.
[*] Fixed potential crash when loading Home Turfs.
[*] Fixed lava texture tiling in Boris' Badlands.
[/list]

notes.title: Georgie-Yolkie 64 - A New Tale Anew, Nintendo Switch 2 and 1.0.8 Patch News
notes.content:
[h1]We are excited to share new updates for GEORGIE-YOLKIE![/h1]

As you are all aware by now, the Nintendo Switch 2 has been announced on Nintendo's Direct.
In response to this, we've had many questions and feedback sent to us by the community, so we are happy to address them.

We have our new game, Georgie-Yolkie 64 - A Furry Tale launching on Steam Early Access this Easter. It will also be avaliable for Nintendo Switch Family and Nintendo Switch 2. Some work that was going into the patch for Georgie-Yolkie has instead been re-used for the new game. In response to this, we will be offering Georgie-Yolkie 64 included for free with Georgie-Yolkie for both new and existing owners.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3588260/GeorgieYolkie_64__The_Furry_Tale/

The 1.0.8 Patch for Georgie-Yolkie is being worked on, along with Armo's Arcade, Cartridges and more. The Felina Township that was shown in the Switch 2 trailer has been instead repurposed for Georgie-Yolkie 64 and will not feature in Georgie-Yolkie.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 (QOL Feature Update) - New Year, New Patch!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of our first new patch for GEORGE-YOLKIE for 2025! This patch adds an important quality of life feature, the silhouette of Georgie when he is obscured by level objects and geometry. This is especially useful as a platformer, the game requires precision platforming at times, and depending on the camera view, objects could obscure the player making it difficult to navigate. With this enhancement, the game is much easier to play, camera wise!

[previewyoutube=UwKIU_Ekl8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, here are some other improvements that have been made to the game;
[list]
[*] Added Day / Night cycle to Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Updated sand around shoreline in Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Textures on Sharkie's Ship are no longer flat and include bump mapping.
[*] Increased mip map (texture) detail from far distances.
[*] Improved rendering quality of models.
[*] Fixed Mermaid bust on front of Sharkie's Ship not moving with the ship, causing it to 'float' midair.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Revision A - Bugfix and minor improvements

This patch includes fixes for a potential crash that could occur with game logic, along with perfecting collisions and performance.

[list]
[*] Fixed null reference exception that could occur in Monty's Jungle.
[*] Fixed inaccurate collisions and bounding boxes for some platforming elements
[*] Fixed Yolkie positioning when using Yolkie Homing in Monty's Jungle

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 (Major Release) - Happy Holidays and New Year!
notes.content:
[h2]We are happy to announce the final patch for 2024 for GEORGIE-YOLKIE!
This patch is a huge one and adds a brand new move, new areas, graphics, bug fixes and enhancements!
The team at Spacefarer wish you a very happy holiday and new year, and that's a wrap for us until next year![/h2]

[previewyoutube=oWGYimkTMHo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Full Changelog[/h3]

[b]🎁 Content Update![/b]
[list]
[*] Added brand new move! [b]Yolkie Homing[/b]- Yolkie when released from the bag will scout the area around Georgie and pick up coins, break stuff and hit enemies from afar! (Press G on keyboard or Y button on controller)
[*] Added the new area in Bobbly's Bog - Pea Soup Plaza, a whole new area with platforming required to get the third golden fishy, instead of it being easily obtained from a simple platform making the level otherwise shorter than it needed to be.
[*] Added new Rainbow platform area to Sweety's Spaces and moved Fishy to the end of it's road, with more coins and Spacefaring cat UFOS as hazards and a cute piggie character!
[*] Added underwater wave and ripple effects underwater in Sharkie's Cove
[*] Added caustics on ocean floors
[*] Added option to change dialogue text speed to Slow, Normal or Fast. (Switch has been changed to Slow)
[*] Added Lanky's Lighthouse to Sharkie's Cove.
[*] New and improved textures with improved UV mapping that was previously stretched on surfaces in Bobbly's Bog, making it much more lush now!
[*] Grass and other foliage will now bend and sway when Georgie moves through it.
[*] When collecting red or blue coinz, a number will popup indicating their value in a fun way!
[/list]

🖌️ [b]Polish[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed swamp ground effect textures and distortions which was not showing correctly before.
[*] Improved graphical effects in Sweety's Spaces
[*] Added smoke in Volcano in Sweety's Spaces.
[*] Updated Sweety's Spaces preview in World Select.
[*] The start button on the Title Screen is now animated.
[*] Added scaling animations to buttons on World Select, File Select and Main Menu and Pause Screens to make them more cute and more obvious of what is selected
[*] Fixed offset of the Tapes button on the World Select screen.
[*] Correct wording for 'Fishys' on World Select to 'Fishies'.
[*] Changed 'Journey' to 'Adventure' on File Select.
[*] Fixed minor UI offset issues.
[*] Added reflections to coins and fishy sprites on menus and HUD.
[*] Fixed fur not appearing on Georgie on the intro where he is laying in bed and Furry Mode is enabled.
[*] Added Fluff to Yolkie when Furry Mode is enabled (Fluffy Chick, Birds don't have fur!)
[*] Added fur to Zeusy when Furry Mode is enabled.
[*] Added fur to Scout when Furry Mode is enabled.
[*] Added fur to Rattie when Furry Mode is enabled.
[*] Fixed blurry icon for Graphic Settings button on the menu.
[*] Restored Crystal ball on Rattie Intro scene which was missing before and not shown until entering his room later.
[*] Doubled the texture resolutions available on higher settings.
[*] Adjusted the coin entry requirement in Monty's Jungle from 1500 coins to 4000 due to Pea Soup Plaza being added. Pea Soup Plaza requires 2000, encouraging exploration of the all the worlds before it.
[*] Fishies are no longer displayed for Rattie's Keep on the UI and has been replaced with Rattie's face as Fishies are not collectable in that world.
[*] Fixed language mistakes in Crocky's Cauldron.
[*] Background billboard trees are now textured instead of being single shaded.
[*] Animated vines and flowers in Teeny-Weeny-Woods instead of being static.
[*] Rattie's Keep coin requirement has been changed from 8000 to 10,000 encouraging exploration of most areas of the game.
[*] Golden Fishies are now seen on the map to help making locating them easier than before.
[*] Added bust of Rattie above door in Rattie's Lair.
[*] Added textures to rocks above water in Sharkie's Cove as it was missing before.
[*] Changed sound effect when picking up the Ice Key to indicate how special it is.
[*] Re-added fog to Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Re-added fog tp Teeny-Weeny's Woods.
[*] Added edges to areas of Isle 'O'Rats as before it was made to appear as if land was hovering above the water.
[/list]

[b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Georgie's fur colouring being too bright in Rattie's Lair when Furry Mode is enabled.

notes.title: Content and Polishing Up Patch (1.0.2) NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]Wow! What a giant patch! This patch polishes off the game and adds new content, graphics, improvements and bug fixes, and stuff that didn't make it into the initial release of the game in time for the holidays, but its all now here in it's glory![/h2]

[h3]New Graphic Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Added Furry Mode [/b]- Enables fur on the characters that have it. It Requires a high end GPU for best performance.
[*] [b]Added Raytracing Support[/b] - Will run on most modern GPUS but requires 4K for best visual fidelity. We recommend you use a high performance GPU to make it look it's best. Adds some really awesome shadow effects and the detail change is outstanding!
[*] [b]Added HDR Display Output [/b]- the game will now display colours correctly on HDR Supported displays.
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Isle 'O' Rats is now fully explorable and the barrier has been removed, allowing entry to the rest of the areas there, which include Armo's Arcade, the Mansion of the Mad March Hares (which is now where the Fishy that was once located above a bee hive on the island has now been moved to). Note that you'll need a game completion star on your save before you can enter those new (optional areas)
[*] The world, Crocky's Cauldron, has been added to the game. Being the last level now before Rattie's Keep, the entry requirement for the Rattie Boss Battle has been changed from 33 Fishies to 36, with Crocky's Cauldron requiring the former. The final coin count requirement for Rattie's Tower has also been inflated from 5000 to 8000. Shortcut portals to Crocky's Cauldron have been added to the Home Turf, Isle 'O 'Rats and Boris' Badlands.
[*] The Instruction Manual is now included in the installation, as it was not included before. It can be accessed from the Technical Support Launch option in Steam or from the game's store page.
[/list]

[h3]We've squashed these bugs![/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor lighting issues on certain objects in Home Turfs.
[*] Fixed minor clipping issues with coins on the ground in Home Turfs.
[*] Fixed Georgie's eyes from glowing when inside Rattie's Lair Hub.
[*] Fixed bloom bugs on certain areas.
[*] Fixed bug with certain objects not rendering correctly.
[*] Fixed lighting that was too dark in Gingy's Glacier.
[*] Removed invisible collision in Magey's Mountain that was left over from development.
[*] Fixed a bug in Sharkie's Cove ocean that would trigger underwater transitions if a enemy or object falls in the water.
[*] Fixed missing collisions on trees on starting point in Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Fixed missing collisions on rocks around the totem poles in Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Fixed aliasing caused by MSAA fallback being downgraded. Default behaviour is now 'upgrade.'
[*] Fixed coin next to tree that would respawn in Home Turfs when it's already picked up which was left over from development.
[*] Fixed bugged lighting on Isle 'O' Rats.
[*] Fixed glitched bee hives obstructing camera on Isle 'O' Rats.
[*] Fixed popup indicator not appearing on portal back to the Home Turfs in Isle 'O' Rats.
[*] Fixed collectables in Gingy's Glacier slightly clipping into surfaces.
[*] Fixed lighting on Christmas Tree from being too dark in Gingy's Glacier.
[*] Fixed the Gold Bobbly not displaying on the Pause UI when in the Isle 'O' Rats World.
[*] Fixed missing tree trunks on certain GPUS in Magey's Mountain.
[*] Fixed deletion bug with certain new game data save creation.
[*] Fixed bug which would reset collected coins on certain worlds (count only, not total saved) in the current world when losing a life or getting game over.
[*] Fixed giant rock which was slighty offset from ground next to the dinosaur skeleton in Boris' Badlands.
[*] Fixed the speech prompt on Sunny in Magey's Mountain from being very off-set from his model.
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug that would reset the amount of coins collected back to 0 when leaving the world and re-entering, requiring the player to surpass the coins collected to a higher new amount in order for them to be saved. They will now be restored when re-entering the level, and new coins collected will add to the combined existing score. This had the potential to cause a softlock as Rattie's tower and other areas require coins to enter.
[*] Fixed random null reference exceptions in Sharkie's Cove.
[*] Fixed starting area in Rattie's Keep being too dark.
[*] Fixed a softlock that could happen on the party scene.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and Polish
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Video settings can now be adjusted on the Pause menu while in-game and also from the File Selection screen, which was restricted to the World Select Screen before.
[*] Added birds to the sky on the Spacefarer Intro
[*] Added Felina skybox in Rattie's Lair.
[*] Rattie's Tapestry Banners now use proper cloth physics and animate instead of being static.
[*] Ropes hanging from Rattie's Lair Balcony now use physics properly instead of being static.
[*] Added flame foes to Boris' Badlands.
[*] Added flame foes outside Croccy's Cauldron portal in Home Turf.
[*] Added flame foes outside Croccy's Cauldron portal in Isle 'O' Rats.
[*] Added coins showing a pathway to the Ice Mountain in Felina Home Turfs.
[*] Major improvement to performance for areas with many collectables on screen by using Dynamic Batching.
[*] Fixed the heart icon not beating as it was not working properly before, resulting in it being static.
[/list]

Thank you for all the early feedback guys, and we hope you continue to enjoy the improvements that we are making to Georgie-Yolkie!

Unless anyone reports any issues this will be our last patch before the holidays, and new year, so we wish you all a good one!

Georgie-Yolkie is an all-new purrfect open-world platformer and collectathon! With huge, beautiful world and meet an unforgettable cast of silly characters.

The lovable duo, Georgie and Yolkie star in this purrfect return to the collectathon platforming genre!

The Worlds of Felina have been overrun by King Rattie’s minions and have stolen all the valuable golden fishies. Now atop his giant keep, Georgie and Yolkie must work together with quirky characters along the way to unlock the vast worlds and bring peace back to the Kingdom.

With a giant open world and no less than ten other worlds full of bright colorful and weird characters, jump, swim, bounce and defy gravity as the worlds of Felina unravel around you, with a fun musical score and excellent replay value.

[b]Key Features[/b]

Jump, run, spin, go upside down, glide, swim and more as you progress through the massive and detailed worlds and combat challenging quirky bosses and meet with silly characters in a humorous story, a love letter to classic platformers of the ninetees!

Ten worlds with different challenges and collect those shiny objects to progress through the worlds of Felina.

A purrfect catchy soundtrack and natural effects that bring the game to life and make it an unforgettable adventure
[b]
And a load more- play challenging mini-games and mix-it-up after beating the game![/b]

Nintendo Switch will also receive the upcoming 1.02 Patch that will be released here on Steam first.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
[h1]Georgie-Yolkie is compatible with Steam Deck™[/h1]

[h2]Read the following below for the results of our testing of the game following the guidelines and structure provided to us by Valve. You can read the guidelines provided [url=https://www.steamdeck.com/en/verified]here.[/url][/h2]

[h3]Input
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Controller support:[/b] The game supports Steam Deck's physical controls. Players will not need to adjust any settings for them to work.
[*] [b]Controller glyphs:[/b] When using the Steam Deck, XBOX / Deck glyphs are displayed, which co-ordinate with the exact controls as provided by Steam Deck.
[/list]
[h3]Display[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Resolution support:[/b] The game supports the Steam Deck's native resolution of 1280x720. It will run by default at 1920x1080 with upscaling.
[*] [b]Default configuration:[/b] The game ships with High configuration for quality setting by default, in which the Steam Deck can run perfectly at 30fps and above.
[*] [b]Text legibility:[/b] interface text can be easily readable at a distance of 12 inches/30 cm from the screen.
[/list]
[h3]Seamlessness[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]No device compatibility warnings:[/b] The game does not present the user with information that the Deck software (ie., specific Linux distribution) or hardware (ie., GPU) is unsupported.
[*] [b]Launcher:[/b] The game does not include a launcher and therefore does not require mouse or keyboard input or breaking the seamless experience from launching the game via Steam.
[/list]
[h3]Proton Requirements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game is provided as a Windows application that is fully supported through Proton as most Unity games are.
[/list]
[b]
Notice: This is not Valve's official compatibility result for Georgie-Yolkie, but we are confident in our results when running the checks with the guidelines provided. The game in the future will be tested by Valve and these results will be updated accordingly.[/b]

notes.title: Post Release - Polishing Up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We'd like to thank you all for your continued support on the release of GEORGIE-YOLKIE since it went GOLD today!

Thanks to you all, Spacefarer has come full circle at releasing our best title yet, and what better to feature our beloved Georgie that started it all. The cat-bird duo are also coming to Nintendo Switch (which went gold and approved weeks ago by Nintendo) and other consoles very soon! How purrfect!

What's next?

Early tester feedback has been amazing, thank you for taking the time to get in touch and sharing both positive and constructive feedback that will allow us to add significant improvements to the game and even add in some of the most requested features. So, coming soon in an update...

[list]
[*] Mini-games in the world levels that are accessible also from Armo's Arcade (A cute armadillo character that didn't make it into the game in time)
[*] The Isle 'O' Rats will be fully explorable, and a preview teaser into what's coming next for Georgie-Yolkie...
[*] Design polish & gameplay tweaks.
[/list]

We'll be sharing a more detailed breakdown of the planned game update in the coming weeks as we make progress.

Until then, we'll be hanging out in our Discord and Community Hub to reach out to everyone to give those handy tips.
